shortDefinition.en: A camera mechanism that moves the sensor to compensate for certain camera movements during capture.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 相机通过移动传感器补偿某些拍摄时相机运动的机构。

en: IBIS compensates for some camera motion; it cannot stop subject movement or guarantee focus.
zh-cn: 机身防抖补偿某些相机运动，不能停止主体运动或保证对焦。

example.en: The X-T5 specification lists a five-axis sensor-shift image-stabilization mechanism.
example.zh-cn: X-T5 规格列出五轴传感器位移图像防抖机构。

sources.title: FUJIFILM X-T5 Specifications
sources.supports: The presence and mechanism of in-body stabilization in this specific camera.
